name: obsidian-mcp
description: Read and search your own Obsidian vault from Claude. Packaging of the third-party MIT-licensed MCPVault server by Mauricio Wolff — your notes stay on your machine.

vault_path.title: Vault folder
vault_path.description: The folder on this computer that holds your notes — the same folder you open in Obsidian. Nothing outside this folder is ever reachable.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Leave ON so Claude can read and search your notes but never change or remove a file. Turning it OFF also enables permanent deletion, which this catalog does not otherwise ship — see the README before changing it.
